## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce

2. Click on '...'

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## Screenshots / Screen Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the bug.

## Environment

- **OS:** [e.g. iOS 18, Windows 11]

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here, such as error messages from the browser console.
